prompt:
A black-and-white CHILDREN'S COLORING BOOK page, square 1:1, 1080x1080. Composition must be SQUARE, never wide or landscape.

CRITICAL — READ FIRST: (a) the drawing must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES with NO frame, NO border line, NO box and NO white margin band; (b) there must be NO starburst, no radiating burst, no sparkle rays and no sunbeam rays anywhere in the picture; (c) use a ZOOMED-IN composition where the main character and the background props all run past every edge of the square, so nothing floats in empty white space.

SCENE: A cheerful cartoon LYSOSOME character runs the friendly little recycling room inside a busy cell, filling almost the whole frame, zoomed in close.
- The LYSOSOME CHARACTER is one big, round, chunky BALLOON / BUBBLE shape with a single simple outline (one wall, no double line), drawn large enough to fill most of the square. It has a big round happy face in the middle of its body: two large round eyes with pupils, cheerful eyebrows, a wide open cheerful grin, and two short stubby cartoon arms with simple mitten hands, one hand raised in a friendly wave or holding a tiny recycling-loop badge on its chest.
- A neat scalloped panel is peeled back like an open round hatch on one side of the character's body, showing the cozy recycling room inside: a few tiny round HELPER characters (simple round blobs with tiny stick arms and a small friendly dot face each) are busy sorting things into two tidy piles — one pile of small worn-out PART characters (a bent little gear shape, a droopy wobbly blob shape, each with a tiny closed sleepy face) waiting to be recycled, and one pile of small neat confetti-like PIECE shapes (simple little squares and triangles, plain and without faces) that have already been broken down and are ready to be reused. A few of the confetti pieces float up out of the open hatch as if about to be sent off to build something new.
- At the open hatch, a round PHAGOSOME FRIEND character (a plain round bubble with a small simple smiling face) is arriving, holding out a small crumb-shaped bit of worn-out material with both mitten hands, handing it over to the lysosome for recycling.
- BACKGROUND, filling the rest of the picture and running off the edges: two or three smaller round lysosome friends peeking in from the corners, each with a simple happy face, partly cut off by the image edge; a loose scatter of small plain confetti-piece shapes floating in the open space to suggest the busy recycling work going on; a few more tiny round helper characters, without faces, drifting off toward the edge of the picture as if heading out to deliver finished pieces to the rest of the cell.
- Everything is drawn LARGE, SIMPLE and CHUNKY, with generous open white areas inside every shape so a child can colour them in.

STYLE — coloring book line art:
- BOLD, THICK, EVEN BLACK OUTLINES on pure WHITE. Every shape fully closed.
- ABSOLUTELY NO shading, NO grey tones, NO hatching, NO stippling, NO cross-hatching, NO gradients, NO colour fill, NO solid black areas anywhere (eyes may have a small solid pupil only).
- Simple, cheerful, chunky cartoon shapes with plenty of white space.

STRICTLY FORBIDDEN — the page is rejected if any of these appear:
- ANY decorative STARBURST, comic-style radiating burst, "pow"/impact star, sparkle burst, twinkle burst, sunbeam rays, radiating speed lines, motion rays or halo of rays behind, around or under any character. NO radiating lines of any kind anywhere. They leave a big empty shape that cannot be removed afterwards.
- ANY rectangle, rounded rectangle, square box outline, picture frame, panel edge, comic panel, border line, outer margin line, ground-line box, shelf, table, counter or vignette. The drawing must NOT sit inside a box of any kind. Do NOT draw a thin black line anywhere near the edge of the image. There must be NO white margin between the artwork and the image edge.
- The artwork must BLEED OFF ALL FOUR EDGES of the square — the background lysosome friends and the drifting helper characters are CUT OFF by the image edge itself.
- NO text, letters, numbers, words, captions, labels or watermarks anywhere.
- NO speech bubble, thought bubble or balloon of any kind (one is added separately afterwards).
- NO detached free-floating scalloped-panel shapes drawn separately from the open hatch rim — the hatch flap must clearly connect to the round body it opens from.
- NO scissors, knives, saws or other sharp tool shapes anywhere — the sorting/recycling work is done by the friendly round helper characters with their hands, never by tools.
- NO human figures, no real flames, no arrows, nothing being squashed, hurt or destroyed unkindly — this is a tidy, cheerful recycling room, not a demolition scene.
